record_level.MECHANISM_TEMPLATE: Literature-supported reusable mechanism/interface template; not a case relation.
record_level.CASE_RELATION: Instantiated relation among entities in a declared case.

scope.CONTEXT: Common-cause/environmental contextual relation; not itself cross-infrastructure causality.

path.MEDIATED: One or more intermediate entities/layers are explicitly represented.

arity.HIGHER_ORDER: At least three participants; pairwise decomposition would lose mechanism meaning.
arity.HIGHER_ORDER_POSSIBLE: Template may require higher-order representation at finer resolution.

structural_existence.TEMPLATE_ONLY: Mechanism template not evaluated in a specific case.
structural_existence.UNRESOLVED: Evidence insufficient to decide structural existence.

case_connection_status.VERIFIED_STRUCTURAL: Case mapping/connection structurally verified; not causal acceptance.

strength_status.NOT_ESTIMATED_STAGE1: Functional coupling magnitude is intentionally not estimated in Stage 1.

confidence_class.HIGH: High epistemic confidence under a declared method.
confidence_class.MEDIUM: Moderate epistemic confidence under a declared method.
confidence_class.LOW: Low epistemic confidence under a declared method.

mechanism_status.PRIOR_DOCUMENTED_FAMILY: Transferable mechanism family established in prior evidence.
mechanism_status.CANDIDATE_ONLY: Candidate mechanism for a case relation; Stage 2 must qualify/falsify.
mechanism_status.CONTEXT_ONLY: Environmental/common-cause context rather than P↔T dependency.

normative_admissibility.PASS: Applicable and satisfied for the declared structural use; does not imply causality.
normative_admissibility.N/A_TEMPLATE: Template has no case-specific normative evaluation.
